title: Implement Web Audio API Sound Effects Synthesizer
description: Implement an audio manager using the Web Audio API to procedurally generate sound effects for jumping, scoring points, and colliding without external audio file dependencies.
acceptanceCriteria: Audio manager initializes WebAudio context successfully on user interaction
Trigger functions generate correct tone frequencies for jump, score, and game over events
Unit tests validate audio node generation and mute state configurations
reviewFeedback: The implementation correctly delivers a procedural Web Audio API synthesizer module with zero external dependencies, robust context initialization, clean mute handling, and comprehensive unit tests running successfully via a Node.js integration harness in pytest.
